translations.web: but while people slept, his enemy came and sowed darnel weeds also among the wheat, and went away.
translations.bsb: But while everyone was asleep, his enemy came and sowed weeds among the wheat, and slipped away.
translations.kjv: But while men slept, his enemy came and sowed tares among the wheat, and went his way.
translations.asv: but while men slept, his enemy came and sowed tares also among the wheat, and went away.
